description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC controller convention that assigns a group name to API controllers based on the route attribute, typically used for organizing API versioning.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A class implementing IControllerModelConvention to set the ApiExplorer.GroupName based on the route attribute of controllers.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Sets the GroupName of the ApiExplorer for a controller based on the route attribute's first segment, defaulting to 'default' if not found.
